row:
This channel is dedicated to Teaching and Celebrating Chiropractic, by explaining chiropractic theory and showing the interactions between colleagues and patients. Videos here are mostly educational discussing chiropractic, chiropractic adjustments, chiropractic theory, manual muscle testing, primitive reflexes, and patient outcomes. A few videos will be personal or contain a comic flare. 

Mark Algee D.C.,  a chiropractor and continuing educational instructor, wishes to explore the relationships between chiropractic, neurology, massage, exercise, nutrition, comedy, kindness, community and The Human Experience. His desire is to have a simple life, that's rich in experience and contributes to humanity by way of healing, teaching, coaching, learning, loving, listening, contributing to others and making people laugh.  If he can accomplish these goals then he's played his part, in this journey called life, well.
